card.fires_on: Small words such as 'to', 'any', 'multiple' or 'the' right after 'allergic' or 'sensitivity' in allergy-history warnings. It also fires weakly on a few other words that take 'to' or 'towards'.

modes.label: Allergy or sensitivity warnings
modes.description: The word right after 'allergic to' or 'sensitivity to', where a list of allergens is about to start.
